canon_ref.note: The day after Erin's request (day 18), so day 19.

b1.queen_allows_workers_visit.summary: Deep in the Hive, the weary Free Queen hears Klbkch out. Other Queens question ten years of failure, so she allows the risk: twelve Workers may visit the Human's inn under his watch. She wants real success within a few years, and a taste of the flies.

canon_ref.note: Same evening as the Workers' visit. Erin calls her 'Rags' here for the first time. Delta is a design value.

b1.rags_brings_goblins_to_eat.summary: The littlest Goblin leads eight others to the inn and holds out a fistful of coins. Erin calls her Rags, takes the money, makes them wash their hands, and feeds them bread, sausage and pasta until they are full.

canon_ref.note: Evening of day 19. The Workers are the ones who dug out the door. Deltas are design values.

b1.workers_learn_chess.summary: Klbkch brings twelve silent Workers to eat Acid Flies; Olesm drops by with a board. Erin plays him without looking, then plays him against Klbkch. A Worker asks to watch; soon Workers and Goblins play on paper boards, and Rags beats two Workers. Erin slips the Workers the paper sets.

system.note: He levels that night; the new level is not given (he was 22).
